name: dclaw-rag-desktop
description: DClaw RAG desktop shell (Electron): local-mode backend + Next.js UI in one window

scripts.build:ui: cd ../frontend && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8090 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_KEY=sk_local npm run build && rm -rf .next/standalone/.next/static .next/standalone/public && cp -r .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static && cp -r public .next/standalone/public
